regions.label: INESHeader
regions.evidence: Parsed and hash-verified iNES header: NES magic, 8 PRG units/16 CHR units, mapper1, no trainer.

regions.label: CHRGraphics
regions.evidence: Header-bounded CHR ROM in separate PPU address space, 8192 16-byte NES 2bpp tiles; observed title, overworld and tutorial graphics demonstrate PPU use. This physical segment is not CPU PRG.
